title: MBC/ZZSH — swapAndLiquifyStepv1() Reserve Manipulation Attack Analysis
root_cause: `swapAndLiquifyStepv1()` is callable by anyone without access control and uses `amountOutMin=0` for internal swaps, forcing execution even under manipulated reserve conditions (missing access control + slippage protection)
steps: Contract's held MBC → converted to USDT at manipulated ratio (large MBC drain)
Reverse swap MBC → USDT (attacker sells held MBC)
